repos_data.description: Local guardrails for AI coding agents. Wraps any MCP server and blocks destructive tool calls — DROP TABLE, rm -rf, force-push, unscoped UPDATE/DELETE — before they execute. Free, open-source, runs entirely on your machine.
The trust and intelligence layer between AI agents and your database. Read-only by architecture, semantic knowledge graph + audit log, MCP-native.
ThumbGate Pre-Action Checks self-improve from ranked lessons and repeated failures, hard-block detected secret leaks, and block matches in strict mode.
An AI that administers Linux through typed, approval-gated, Ed25519-audited actions. The model selects the action; the daemon builds the command.
AgentBase MCP server — search and retrieve agent instruction files via MCP tools
Your AI's shortcut to mastering Claude Code's architecture — 310K lines distilled into 32 queryable modules via MCP.
Open-source observability and audit trail platform for AI agents. MCP-native, tamper-evident event logging, real-time dashboard.
Agentic development harness for Claude Code — SPEC-driven plan/run/sync, TRUST 5 quality gates, model+effort routing, and Claude×GLM multi-LLM cost control. Single Go binary, 16 languages, zero deps.

Tamper-evident audit log for Go: an append-only, hash-chained, optionally Ed25519-signed log/slog handler, with offline logx verify. Built on the standard library, zero third-party dependencies. Also a full slog toolkit (colored output, JSON, rotation, fan-out, CLI).
A private, open-source AI-text checker that runs entirely on your machine
Download mirror for the Proofpane MCP daemon. Source stays in the private codebase; this exists so browsers (Chrome Safe Browsing, Edge SmartScreen) trust the download.

Self-maintaining and persistent codebase memory for AI coding agents — a deterministic AST index plus agent-written notes that flag themselves stale when the code changes. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex via MCP + CLI.
